title: स्नातक तहको शिक्षण अभ्यासप्रति सम्बन्धित छात्रशिक्षकहरूको दृष्टिकोण Snatak Tahako Shikshan Abhyasprati Sambandhit Chhatrashikshakharuko Drishtikon
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख स्नातक तहको शिक्षण अभ्यास पाठ्यांश (४४०) प्रति सम्बन्धित छात्रशिक्षकहरूद्वाराव्यक्त दृष्टिकोणसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालयद्वारा स्नातक तहकोशिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्कायअन्तर्गत चौथो वर्षका लागि तयार पारिएको शिक्षण अभ्यास पाठ्यांशको सम्बन्धमासोधिएका प्रश्नहरूप्रति छात्रशिक्षकहरूद्वारा व्यक्त दृष्टिकोण के कस्तो रहेको छ भनी अध्ययन विश्लेषणगरिएको छ । अतः स्नातक तहको शिक्षण अभ्यास पाठ्यांशप्रति छात्रशिक्षकहरूका दृष्टिकोण पत्तालगाउनु तथा छात्रशिक्षकहरूद्वारा व्यक्त दृष्टिकोणको विश्लेषण गर्नु प्रस्तुत लेखको उद्देश्य रहेकोछ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा मूलतः सर्वेक्षण विधिबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनमाआवश्यकताअनुसार पुस्तकालयीय विधि तथा मिश्रित अनुसन्धान ढाँचाको अवलम्बन गरिएको छ ।लेख तयारीका लागि प्राथमिक र द्वितीय दुवै स्रोतबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । निर्दिष्ट पाठ्यांशपरिमार्जित र परिवर्तित पाठ्यांश हो । यसलाई प्रथम पटक २०७५÷०७६ को शैक्षिक सत्रदेखिकार्यान्वयनमा ल्याइएको हो । यसरी प्रथम पटक प्रयोगमा ल्याउने सन्दर्भमा यसमा पहिलो समूह (फस्टब्याच) का रूपमा संलग्न भएका छात्रशिक्षक÷विद्यार्थीहरूका दृष्टिकोण बुझ्न विकल्पसहितका आठओटा बन्द र दुई ओटा खुला गरी जम्मा दश फरक–फरक प्रकृतिका प्रश्नहरू निर्माण गरिएका छन् ।उक्त प्रश्नहरूप्रति सम्बन्धित छात्रशिक्षकहरूको दृष्टिकोण व्यक्त गर्न लगाइएको छ । यस क्रममा प्राप्त तथ्याङ्कहरूलाई प्रतिशतमा लगी सूक्ष्म रूपमा त्यसको समीक्षण गरिएको छ । यसमा रहेका सबलपक्ष र सुधारात्मक पक्षहरूलाई निष्कर्षका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article relates to the perspectives expressed by the concerned student teachers toward the undergraduate student teaching course (440). In this article, an analytical study is conducted on what perspectives student teachers expressed in response to questions asked concerning the student teaching curriculum prepared by Tribhuvan University for the fourth year under the Faculty of Education at the undergraduate level. Thus, the objective of this article is to determine student teachers' perspectives on the undergraduate student teaching curriculum and to analyze the perspectives they expressed. In this article, materials were gathered primarily through a survey method. A library-based method and a mixed-methods research design were adopted in this study as needed. Materials were gathered from both primary and secondary sources for the preparation of the article. The specified curriculum is a revised and modified course of study. It was brought into implementation for the first time starting from the academic session 2075/076 BS. In the context of implementing it for the first time, a total of ten questions of distinct types—eight closed-ended questions with options and two open-ended questions—were formulated to understand the perspectives of the student teachers/students involved as the first batch. The concerned student teachers were asked to express their perspectives on those questions. The data obtained during this process was converted into percentages and closely examined. The strengths and areas needing improvement contained within it have been presented as conclusions.
british_english: The present article concerns the views expressed by the student teachers involved regarding the undergraduate teaching practice curriculum (440). In the present article, an analytical investigation is undertaken into the nature of the perspectives expressed by student teachers in response to questions posed regarding the teaching practice curriculum drawn up by Tribhuvan University for the fourth year under the Faculty of Education at the bachelor's level. Thus, the aim of the present article is to ascertain student teachers' views regarding the undergraduate teaching practice curriculum and to analyse the views expressed by them. In the present article, data was collected primarily by means of a survey method. A desk-based library method and a mixed-methods research framework were adopted in this study as required. Data was gathered from both primary and secondary sources for the compilation of the article. The designated syllabus is a revised and amended syllabus. It was implemented for the first time from the academic session 2075/076 BS. In connection with putting it into practice for the first time, a total of ten questions of differing natures—comprising eight closed questions with options and two open questions—were designed to ascertain the perspectives of the student teachers and pupils involved as the initial intake (first batch). The student teachers in question were invited to express their views on those questions. The data obtained during this exercise was converted into percentages and subjected to close appraisal. The merits and aspects requiring improvement identified therein have been presented as conclusions.
australian_english: This paper is about the perspectives shared by the student teachers concerned regarding the undergraduate teaching practicum course (440). In this paper, an analytical study looks into what kind of views student teachers put forward in response to questions asked about the teaching practicum curriculum drawn up by Tribhuvan University for fourth year under the Faculty of Education at the undergraduate level. So the whole aim of this article is to find out student teachers' views on the undergraduate teaching practicum curriculum and analyse what they had to say. In this paper, material was gathered mostly using a survey method. In this study, a library method and a mixed-methods research framework were used as needed. Material was collected from both primary and secondary sources to put the paper together. The curriculum in question is an updated and modified syllabus. It was rolled out for the first time from the 2075/076 BS academic year. In rolling it out for the first time like this, ten different questions in total—eight closed questions with options and two open-ended ones—were drawn up to see what the student teachers and students involved in that first batch thought. The student teachers involved were asked to share their perspectives on those questions. The data gathered along the way was converted into percentages and closely reviewed. The strengths and areas needing work identified in it have been set out as conclusions.
informal_english: This article is all about the views shared by student teachers on the undergraduate student teaching course (440). This paper digs into what student teachers had to say when asked about the fourth-year teaching practicum curriculum put together by Tribhuvan University under the Faculty of Education for undergrads. So the main goal of the paper is to figure out what student teachers think about the undergraduate student teaching course and break down their views. For this study, the data was collected mostly through a survey. The study also pulled in desk research and a mixed-methods setup wherever it made sense. Materials were gathered from both primary and secondary sources to put this article together. The curriculum in question is an updated and overhauled course. It was first rolled out starting in the 2075/076 BS academic year. Since it was being rolled out for the first time, ten different questions—eight multiple-choice closed questions and two open-ended ones—were put together to see what the student teachers and students in that first batch actually thought. The student teachers involved were asked to share their thoughts on those questions. The data that came back was turned into percentages and looked over closely. The good parts and the areas that need fixing were then laid out as conclusions.
